title: npm Supply Chain Risk Scanner input
description: Scan explicit npm package specs, a repository manifest, or both. At least one package or package.json URL is required.

packages.title: Packages
packages.description: npm package specs such as left-pad, left-pad@1.3.0, or @scope/package@latest.

packageJsonUrl.title: package.json or repository URL
packageJsonUrl.description: Raw package.json URL or public GitHub repository URL. Direct dependencies and devDependencies are scanned.

includeTransitive.title: Include transitive dependencies
includeTransitive.description: Scan transitive dependencies when package-lock.json is available. pnpm and Yarn lockfiles are detected but not parsed in v1.

maxPackages.title: Maximum packages
maxPackages.description: Safety cap applied after exact name and version pairs are deduplicated.

failThreshold.title: Fail threshold
failThreshold.description: Finish the run as FAILED when a scanned package has this risk score or higher.
